title: Ordinary sheaf site comparison respects open exchange
statement: For a finite commutative ring Lambda, every chosen open-immersion square with arbitrary bottom map, and every ordinary etale Lambda-module sheaf F, the actual sheaf-level site comparisons intertwine the actual etale and pro-etale open exchange isomorphisms. Precisely, g_pro^*(c_j,F);e_pro,NUF;jprime_!(rho_h,F) = rho_g,j!F;N_Xprime(e_et,F);c_jprime,h*F. The pro-etale exchange is the inverse of the conjugate of the specified ProEtale.baseChangeMap; the etale exchange is the inverse of Etale.openImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeMap. No derived-category object or localization appears.

source.place: Tag 03S6, label lemma-shriek-base-change, proof by comparison of right adjoints; the specified unit-normalized compatibility is the agent elaboration extracted from returned proof step 8.

proof.text: The pro-etale ordinary exchange is the inverse conjugate of ProEtale.baseChangeMap. This delivery proves fixSiteOpenSheafExchangeIso_unit: the base-change map is the iterated mate of upperStarCompIso; the conjugation unit identity, the mate unit identity and naturality give the inverse exchange unit formula. The formal argument is proved first for abstract adjunctions and then instantiated. The etale inverse-unit formula is the already proved upstream Etale.unit_map_openImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeMap_app.

Apply openComparison_unit_normalization to the specified comparison c_j and convert restriction coordinates using upperStarIsoOpenImmersionRestriction on both sites. Postcompose with the pullback of c_j inverse. The inverse-unit formula becomes eta_pro; j_pro^*(c_j inverse) = N_U(eta_et); rho_j inverse. Do the same for jprime. The specialized inverse-image square equation is supplied by lem-fix-site-open-exchange-square.

Invert the two displayed isomorphism composites. Apply the injective Hom correspondence of jprime_! adjoint to jprime^*. Naturality of the open unit moves rho_h inverse to the beginning on the left. The proved pro-etale inverse-unit formula, naturality of its square comparison and the preceding inverse-unit normalization rewrite its transpose as N_Uprime(h_et^* eta_j); rho_h inverse; h_pro^*(rho_j inverse); sigma_pro. On the right, apply the inverse-unit normalization for c_jprime and naturality of rho_jprime inverse, followed by the upstream etale inverse exchange unit formula. Its transpose is N_Uprime(h_et^* eta_j); N_Uprime(sigma_et); rho_jprime inverse; jprime_pro^*(rho_g inverse). The cartesian-square coherence clause of supportSiteComparison_pullback_coherent identifies the factors following the common unit. The Hom bijection is injective, so the inverse composites are equal, and inversion gives the stated equation. The same argument covers empty opens, identity squares and zero coefficients. The specialized inverse-image square equation is supplied by lem-fix-site-open-exchange-square.

theorem fixSiteOpenExchangeSheaf (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {U' U X' X : Scheme.{u}} {gU : U' ⟶ U} {j' : U' ⟶ X'}
    {j : U ⟶ X} {g : X' ⟶ X} [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsOpenImmersion j']
    (sq : OpenImmersionSquare gU j' j g)
    (F : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).map
        ((openImmersionLowerShriekComparisonUpperStarIso
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j).hom.app F) ≫
      (fixSiteOpenSheafExchangeIso Λ gU j' j g
        (IsPullback.of_iso_pullback sq.toCommSq sq.isoPullback sq.hom_fst sq.hom_snd)).hom.app
          ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) U).obj F) ≫
      (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j').map
        ((comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) gU).hom.app F) =
    (comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).hom.app
        ((Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j).obj F) ≫
      (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X').map
        ((@asIso _ _ _ _ _ (Etale.isIso_openImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeMap
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
          (IsPullback.of_iso_pullback sq.toCommSq sq.isoPullback sq.hom_fst
            sq.hom_snd))).inv.app F) ≫
      (openImmersionLowerShriekComparisonUpperStarIso
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j').hom.app
          ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) gU).obj F)
